Primary request: create one beautiful professional design-studio presentation with a large exact wordmark, original mascot illustration, brand mark, four-color palette, and a wide wallpaper concept shown in a minimal desktop preview. Give each element room. Visual hierarchy: large wordmark upper left; editorial mascot illustration left center; large landscape wallpaper right center in a plain thin screen rectangle, without physical device hardware; palette and tiny one-color mark proof at bottom. On the wallpaper preview show only a very small tasteful top bar and tiny five-icon dock, without app windows. Include small light and dark brand-mark tiles to demonstrate range. Use precise generous margins and consistently aligned baselines. All lettering must be legible, only the requested brand name, tagline, small label "DESKTOP CONCEPT", and four hex values. No extra marketing copy or nonsense text.
Brand constraints: warm human craft, calm premium studio quality, welcoming to nontechnical people, no terminals or code, no penguins, no cyberpunk, no AI motifs, no shiny tech or glassmorphism, no mock functionality or feature claims. Mascot is identity artwork, not an assistant. Colors are brand colors; desktop UI chrome should remain visually neutral. No famous existing logos or characters, no watermark.

Brand name (verbatim): "Ochrelark" (spell O-c-h-r-e-l-a-r-k). Tagline (verbatim): "An open canvas for every day."
Creative territory: The independent art school. Ochre is a tactile artist's pigment; lark brings openness, movement, and a little joy.
Mascot: Olli, a lark built from three broad pigment shapes.
Style/medium: Bold European modernist art-school poster, cut-paper and screenprint texture, large intentional color planes, highly refined expressive serif wordmark, crisp graphic lark.
Brand mark: An ochre open circle crossed once by a blue ascending wing; compact and geometric.
Subject and wallpaper: A lark made from a rounded ochre body, one ultramarine wing and a simple carbon beak, lively but calm stance; wallpaper is broad ochre circles and blue cut-paper arcs on canvas with generous blank center.
Color palette: Canvas #F5EEDC; Ochre #CA983B; Ultramarine #3656A6; Carbon #292D34. Show four flat color swatches with these exact hex labels, in this order. No extra colors apart from white/black in the neutral UI proof.
Composition: refined unified landscape identity board; prioritize character silhouette and wallpaper beauty; keep texture restrained enough for crisp logo reproduction.
